findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/acceptance-topology.ts:635 mode-dependent status derivation downgrades missing/partial/unsupported basis to status=warn in observe/warn, but returns inconclusive only in enforce because status branches on blocking. This violates B98B0-M1-E-NONPASS-BASIS and B98B0-M1-E-MODES: basis incompleteness must remain INCONCLUSIVE and the canonical evaluation result must be mode-invariant; only blocking may differ. The focused mode loop exercises only clean complete bases, so it cannot detect this regression. Derive status from structural/basis semantics independently of mode, then derive blocking from mode, and add failing-basis assertions across observe/warn/enforce.
